description: Labelled sample of COBOL findings (Phase 3). Each label applies the per-rule criteria below to the source at the reported line; the criteria were applied with a helper script and every category was spot-checked by hand. verdict TP = the finding is a real instance of what the rule describes; FP = it is not. sets = which run produced it (before = main 43a777e, v4.14.1; after = Phase 3 branch; leftovers = Phase 3 leftovers branch, same labels re-applied to the findings that remain). duplicate = n-th identical finding at the same place.

corpora.nist: NIST COBOL85 test suite (newcob.val, GnuCOBOL mirror), file = member name + .CBL

sampling: CardDemo, GenApp and zopeneditor: every finding of each rule, except CardDemo COBOL007 before (60 of 257, random). NIST: random 20 of COBOL004/COBOL007/COBOL011, 10 of COBOL001/COBOL003/COBOL006, every COBOL005; seed 2026.
caveats: COBOL007 TP means the copybook really is COPYed by 5+ programs (the rule definition); it does not judge whether that blast radius is a risk. COBOL011 TP means the SELECT really lacks FILE STATUS; its Phase 3 change is about volume and severity, not precision.

criteria.COBOL001: TP when the file really has more than 10 GO TO statements
criteria.COBOL003: TP when the line ACCEPTs external input (SYSIN, console, terminal)
criteria.COBOL004: TP when packed, binary, pointer or signed numeric data is overlaid with a different layout; FP for alphanumeric/unsigned display overlays, generated BMS maps and the deliberate 2-byte file-status decoding idiom
criteria.COBOL005: TP for a real OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON entry reported on its own line; FP for the CICS EIBCALEN commarea idiom, GO TO DEPENDING, RECORD VARYING and duplicates
criteria.COBOL006: TP when the PERFORM THRU range spans more than 5 paragraphs
criteria.COBOL007: TP when the copybook is COPYed by at least 5 programs of the corpus; FP for vendor copybooks, non-names and copybooks used by 1-4 programs
criteria.COBOL008: TP for a real literal credential in a VALUE clause
criteria.COBOL011: TP when the SELECT has no FILE STATUS clause
criteria.COBOL015: TP when the copybook is really absent from the repository
